request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Make him a heavy gunner with a new outline: replace the helmet antenna with one tall chrome fin crest like a rocket fin; add a dark gunmetal visor band across the top front of the glass helmet; make his back pack much bigger and boxier, with one thick coiled black cable looping to the rifle; widen his stance. Keep the huge finned rifle with its magenta emitter ball, his lavender face, big black eyes, silver suit, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
